title: Hunter Biden on Bitcoin, Operation Chokepoint 2.0, and $LAPTOP
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Hunter Biden on Bitcoin, Operation Chokepoint 2.0, and $LAPTOP Hunter Biden explains why $LAPTOP crashed 98% post-launch, blaming a DEX market maker liquidity failure, and shares his long-term Bitcoin price prediction.
